title: THE YEAR OF THE CAT
lyrics_synced:
[01:11.94] On a morning from a Bogart movie
[01:16.19] In a country where they turn back time
[01:20.17] You go strolling through the crowd
[01:22.31] like Peter Lorre.
[01:24.42] Contemplating a crime
[01:28.67] She comes out of the sun in a silk dress running
[01:32.93] Like a watercolor in the rain
[01:37.96] Don't bother asking for explanations
[01:41.68] She'll just tell you that she came
[01:44.73] in the year of the cat
[02:03.06] She doesn't give you time for questions
[02:07.04] As she's lockin' up your arm in hers
[02:11.29] And you follow 'till your sense of which direction
[02:15.65] Completely disappears
[02:19.91] By the blue tiled walls near the market stalls
[02:24.15] There's a hidden door she leads you to
[02:28.93] These days, she says, I feel my life
[02:32.13] Just like a river running through
[02:35.85] The year of the cat
[02:53.63] And she looks at you so cooly
[02:57.87] And her eyes shine like the moon in the sea
[03:01.86] She comes in incense and patchouli
[03:06.37] So you take her, to find what's waiting inside
[03:14.07] The year of the cat.
[04:42.21] Well morning comes and you're still with her
[04:46.47] And the bus and the tourists are gone
[04:50.70] And you've thrown away the choice
[04:52.83] and lost your ticket
[04:54.96] So you have to stay on
[04:59.19] But the drumbeat strains of the night remain
[05:03.44] In the rhythm of the newborn day
[05:08.36] You know sometime you're bound to leave her
[05:11.94] But for now you're going to stay
[05:15.01] In the year of the cat.
